fields.description:
The igPublisher reads structure definitions in the resource directory and writes new ones in the output directory. As well as expected changes (e.g. creating a snapshot) it changes some element ids. Sometimes it converts camel-case to lower-case and sometimes changes part of the id.

         File from resource is +immunization-air.xml+         

         File from output is +StructureDefinition-immunization-air.xml+         

         Is this expected behaviour?

comments.body: do you mean it changes the file names?  and the fragments are all prefixed with the type.   that is expected...
elementId values must follow a specific algorithm.  If the ids weren't correct, the publishing process will "fix" them.  This is expected behavior.

I'm suprised that this

             <element id="Immunization.extension:cancellation*P*eriod">\\      <path value="Immunization.extension" />\\      <sliceName value="cancellationPeriod" />

                     \\changes to

             <element id="Immunization.extension:cancellation*p*eriod">\\      <path value="Immunization.extension"/>\\      <sliceName value="cancellationPeriod"/>

And this

             <element id="Immunization.reportOrigin">\\      <path value="Immunization.reportOrigin" />\\      <min value="1" />\\      <fixedCodeableConcept>\\        <text value="Australian Immunisation Register" />\\      </fixedCodeableConcept>\\    </element>\\    <element id="Immunization.*explanation*.reasonNotGiven">\\      <path value="Immunization.explanation.reasonNotGiven" />

                     \\changes to

             <element id="Immunization.reportOrigin">\\      <path value="Immunization.reportOrigin"/>\\      <min value="1"/>\\      <fixedCodeableConcept>\\        <text value="Australian Immunisation Register"/>\\      </fixedCodeableConcept>\\    </element>\\    <element id="Immunization.*reportOrigin*.reasonNotGiven">\\      <path value="Immunization.explanation.reasonNotGiven"/>

         It seems to copy part of the id from the preceding element in the snapshot, rather than the correct parent in the hierarchy.

A later version of these files changes

             <element id="Immunization.manufacturer">\\      <path value="Immunization.manufacturer" />\\      <type>\\        <code value="Reference" />\\        <targetProfile value="[http://hl7.org.au/fhir/StructureDefinition/au-organisation]" />\\      </type>\\    </element>\\    <element id="Immunization.*practitioner*.actor">\\      <path value="Immunization.practitioner.actor" />\\      <type>\\        <code value="Reference" />\\        <targetProfile value="[http://hl7.org.au/fhir/StructureDefinition/au-practitioner]" />\\      </type>\\    </element>\\    <element id="Immunization._               +explanation+            _.reasonNotGiven">\\      <path value="Immunization.explanation.reasonNotGiven" />

                     \\to

             <element id="Immunization.manufacturer">\\      <path value="Immunization.manufacturer"/>\\      <type>\\        <code value="Reference"/>\\        <targetProfile value="[http://hl7.org.au/fhir/StructureDefinition/au-organisation]"/>\\      </type>\\    </element>\\    <element id="Immunization.*manufacturer*.actor">\\      <path value="Immunization.practitioner.actor"/>\\      <type>\\        <code value="Reference"/>\\        <targetProfile value="[http://hl7.org.au/fhir/StructureDefinition/au-practitioner]"/>\\      </type>\\    </element>\\    <element id="Immunization._               +manufacturer+            _.reasonNotGiven">\\      <path value="Immunization.explanation.reasonNotGiven"/>

Unable to reproduce the problem.

         Must have been fixed already.

         Please close.
